note: Le mur des pots: ground-floor front room (west half) of L'Atelier du Peintre, camera facing north. Cornflower-blue limewash, pale limed-oak floorboards; landmark = the floor-to-ceiling rainbow wall of paint pots with its rolling ladder. Only noun: la couleur (f), front left; the other words are colour adjectives (no gender). Glazed double door on the left (west) shows the square (fountain, clock tower) and leads out; spiral stair in the back-left corner goes UP to the loft frame room (R_shapes_03); the arch on the right (east) shows the sage-tiled dye room (R_colors_02). Zone z1 = the upper-left paint-pot shelves.
